run_generate_text: run the generate.py CLI to load a consolidated LLM checkpoint and generate text from user prompts
sample_tokens_top_p: sample tokens from model logits using top_p nucleus sampling with configurable temperature
sample_tokens_top_k: sample tokens from model logits using top_k sampling to restrict to the k most probable tokens
pack_prompts_packed: pack multiple tokenized prompts into a single concatenated tensor with per-prompt length tracking
load_consolidated_model: load a consolidated LMTransformer model and tokenizer from a checkpoint directory with params.json config
